learning_objective: 🎯 We will learn to spot lovely patterns and make our own repeating designs for decorations!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: A pattern is when shapes, colors, or numbers repeat in the same order again and again. Like a red balloon, blue balloon, red balloon, blue balloon!
We can find patterns everywhere. Look at a leaf, a butterfly's wings, or the stripes on a zebra. Nature loves to decorate!
During festivals, we decorate our houses with leaves and flowers. We can make a beautiful pattern string using one mango leaf, then one marigold flower, repeating it over and over.

fun_activity.title: 🎨 Spoon and Bowl Pattern
fun_activity.instructions: Go to your kitchen. Make a fun pattern line on the table: Spoon, Bowl, Spoon, Bowl. Ask your parents what comes next!

quick_recap: ⭐ A pattern is created when things repeat in a rule or order.
⭐ We can find patterns in clothes, nature, and numbers.
⭐ Creating patterns is a fun way to decorate our homes for festivals.
